title: Grateful Dead Live at Rainbow Theater on 1981-03-20
lineage: master soundboard cassettes > Nak Dr-1 > Lynx2 Studio Interface 24 bit 48kHz. Edited and Mastered by Jamie Waddell on the **GEMS** Edit Station Weiss-Saracon for SRC and Pow-r3 Dither to 16 bit 44.1 kHz MetaData with Tag and Rename TLH for FLAC Level 8  SBE FREE Seeded on The Winter Solstice 2009 (Note: The original 12-21-2009 version of this source had flaws and should not be circulated.)

ai_review.summary: Crisp early‑80s soundboard captures a stellar Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain performance with tight band playing.
ai_review.review: The recording is an early‑80s soundboard that sounds “sooo crispy,” with drums perfectly mixed and each instrument holding its own. The show shines on the Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain transition, ranking among the reviewer’s top‑20 scarlet fires, and even features a unique doowop riff by Jerry in C.C. Rider. Overall the set is tidy, well‑played and flows nicely despite a modest Fire segue.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed five‑star review praises both the musical performance and the soundboard quality; other reviews are neutral, giving a strong but not fully corroborated positive rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp intro, slight delay after first chords, drums mixed perfectly, balanced mix where every instrument is clear and distinct.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: A tidy, well‑played set; the transition into Fire is modest but notable as the first European show of ’81, overall a smooth flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Unique doowop riff in C.C. Rider highlighted; guitar tone described as crisp and perfect.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are mixed perfectly, each instrument holds its own.
